regime_context: The Hong Kong detector shows a narrow leadership structure: only 4 of 17 themes are trend-gate eligible, led by Banks (H + HK) and Energy (H-shares) on momentum; the gate_helps flag is true, but the backtest verdict confirms rank-IC ~0 and no rotation-timing edge, so this is a focus/risk lens only. Cross-sectional momentum is weak in-sample and breadth of rotation is narrow (0.24), so any lean must be low-conviction and falsifiable.
emerging_watch: Watch whether China Tech & Internet (3033.HK, scorable, rank 13, hurst_tag mean-revert, score -0.792) starts to establish trend-gate eligibility with breadth above 0.4; if it becomes eligible while its score turns positive, that would mark a possible confirmed handoff from the current financials/energy leadership. I am watching for eligible=true on hk_china_tech with breadth>=0.4.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks (H + HK) is the only theme that is trend-gate eligible AND ranks #1 on momentum with a durability_bar of 0.67 and breadth of 0.692, the strongest coherence among eligible leaders. This is a relative-focus lean: within an eligible universe of just 4 names, banks show the best combination of trend eligibility and durability, with crowding_z 0.93 still below the crowded threshold.
theses.dissent: H-shares banks are policy-sensitive to PBOC rate and property-exposure headlines; the macro_narrative backdrop shows unscheduled_share 1.0, meaning surprise-driven tape risk is high, and momentum rank has no return edge in backtests, so this leadership may be fragile and mean-revert.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) loses trend-gate eligibility (eligible goes false) before the check-by date

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy (H-shares) is the challenger in the rotation radar with a durability_bar of 0.76 (highest of all themes) and breadth 0.8, the strongest trend-health reading in the top ranks. Its hurst_tag is 'trend' rather than 'mixed', suggesting cleaner directional persistence than banks. This is an eligible, non-crowded focus lean on the strongest trend-health profile.
theses.dissent: Commodity-linked energy is hostage to global oil/coal price swings and USD-HKD funding conditions rather than HK domestic dynamics; with only 4 eligible themes and a narrow rotation, challenger leadership may be short-lived and reverse without warning.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) breadth drops below 0.5 or durability_bar drops below banks' before the check-by date
